seats.findings: 🔴 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX couponCents divides by 1000 instead of 100, so the discount is one tenth of the specified Math.round(subtotal * p / 100); checkoutTotal therefore overcharges every discounted order (e.g. subtotal 10000, pct 10 yields discount 100 instead of 1000); change the divisor in src/coupon.js to 100

🟠 [coupon-divisor-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js computes the discount as Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000) instead of /100, undercharging the discount by 10× (e.g. subtotal=2000, pct=50 yields 100¢ instead of the contracted 1000¢); this also propagates into checkoutTotal, whose contract requires discount = Math.round(subtotal * p / 100), corrupting both the discount and the tax base (subtotal=2000, pct=50, rateBp=1000 gives 2090¢ instead of 1100¢); smallest remediation: change the divisor 1000 → 100 in src/coupon.js, which repairs both couponCents and checkoutTotal with no other edits

🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX couponCents divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`), producing a discount 10× smaller than the spec requires (`Math.round(subtotal * p / 100)`); this propagates into checkoutTotal and makes every discounted checkout total wrong. Fix: change the divisor from 1000 to 100 in src/coupon.js.

🔴 [checkout-double-subtract] MUST-FIX coupon.js now returns the remaining subtotal (subtotal minus discount) but checkout.js still does `subtotal - couponCents(subtotal, pct)`, so `discounted` becomes the discount amount itself; checkoutTotal(10000, 10, 800, 0) returns 1000+80=1080 instead of 9000+720=9720, violating the checkoutTotal contract and inverting every discounted total; smallest fix: in checkout.js set `const discounted = couponCents(subtotal, pct);` (or revert coupon.js to return the discount amount and keep the subtraction, matching its original header comment)
🔵 [clamp-nan] CUT/FOLLOW-UP clampQty(NaN) returns NaN rather than a value in 1..99; spec does not define non-numeric input, so excluded from this version

🟠 [checkout-double-discount] MUST-FIX in src/checkout.js `discounted = subtotal - couponCents(subtotal, pct)` double-applies the coupon: couponCents was changed to return the post-discount subtotal (subtotal - round(subtotal*p/100)), so `subtotal - couponCents(...)` yields the DISCOUNT, not the taxable amount, and the function returns discount + tax(discount) + shipping; e.g. checkoutTotal(10000, 10, 1000, 0) returns 1100 instead of 9900, and pct=0 returns just shipping (0 for weight 0 instead of 11000), so every input is wrong; smallest fix: `const discounted = couponCents(subtotal, pct);` (or revert couponCents to return the discount per its original contract)

🟠 [checkout-double-subtract] MUST-FIX In src/checkout.js, `const discounted = subtotal - couponCents(subtotal, pct)` computes the discount amount rather than the taxable amount, because couponCents already returns `subtotal - Math.round(subtotal*p/100)`. The subsequent `discounted + taxCents(discounted, rateBp) + shippingCents(weightG)` therefore taxes and sums the discount instead of the post-discount subtotal, producing incorrect totals (e.g. subtotal=1000, pct=10, rateBp=500, weightG=0 returns 100+5+0=105 instead of 900+45+0=945). Smallest fix: change to `const discounted = couponCents(subtotal, pct);` (remove the `subtotal - `).
